gaps.title: Cryptographic Verification for SSO Tokens
gaps.jtbd: When a user logs in via Moodle SSO, I want the system to cryptographically verify their token signatures, so that arbitrary authentication bypass is prevented.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an OIDC or LTI login request, When the payload is processed, Then the system verifies the token signature against the IdP JWKS or validates the OAuth 1.0 HMAC-SHA1 signature, rejecting unverified tokens.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Proper SSO implementations must cryptographically verify tokens instead of using hardcoded string-matching stubs to ensure security.
